sketches.mechanism: A non-Copy value is moved into the first call, so the second use is rejected at compile time as a use after move.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away cannot be given again, because the language remembers the departure.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because no sender can ever rendezvous with it.
sketches.resonance: Waiting on a path that was never made becomes an endless, formal patience.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table field removes the field, and reading a missing field yields nil.
sketches.resonance: Absence cannot be stored; the moment it is placed somewhere, the place becomes empty.
